moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lk-riso, written here): Two copies of the art in print inks (cyan #2ec4e8, pink #ff4fa3) blended multiply, offset in opposite directions by (o, o/2): o steps 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 px, one step per 12 fps frame (~83 ms; recipe 4 -> 3 -> 2 over 3 frames), cycling.
